root_cause: The container image "nginx:does-not-exist" could not be found in the registry.
The pod cannot pull the image because the registry host "registry.invalid" cannot be resolved by DNS.
The pod’s image reference "nginx::bad" is not a valid Docker image name, causing the kubelet to reject it before pulling.
The container exits immediately because the required environment variable DB_URL is not set.
The container exits immediately because it cannot connect to the Postgres service at db:5432, causing a CrashLoopBackOff.
The pod’s container was killed because it exceeded its memory limit (OOMKilled). The stress command requests 200 MiB of memory while the pod is limited to 50 MiB.
The container failed to start because the specified command "/bin/doesnotexist" does not exist in the image.
The pod requests 1k CPU, which exceeds the available CPU on the cluster nodes, causing a scheduling failure.
The pod cannot start because the ConfigMap "app-config" referenced in its spec is missing.
The pod cannot start because the referenced secret "db-credentials" is missing.
